report_name: Microsoft Details Destructive Cloud Tactics of JADEPUFFER

threat_actors.name: Storm-3168
threat_actors.description: An 'agentic ransomware' group that conducted a highly destructive, automated campaign in Microsoft Azure. The group leveraged compromised service principals for rapid reconnaissance and destruction of cloud resources, including storage accounts, key vaults, and backups.
threat_actors.goals: To destroy cloud data and prevent recovery, likely to increase leverage for a ransom demand.

attack_patterns.name: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Gained initial access by compromising at least two service principals within a single Azure tenant, with one potentially compromised via credentials exposed in a public GitHub issue.

attack_patterns.name: Cloud Service Discovery
attack_patterns.description: Used a compromised service principal to perform over 300 successful read operations over a 15-hour period to enumerate the victim's cloud environment, including virtual machines, subscriptions, resource groups, and storage accounts.

attack_patterns.name: Data Destruction
attack_patterns.description: Executed a rapid, automated destructive phase, issuing over 100 deletion requests for storage accounts, an Azure Key Vault, a Function App, and an App Service plan in seven minutes.

attack_patterns.name: Disk Wipe
attack_patterns.description: Attempted to delete Azure Site Recovery locks and Azure Backup protection to prevent victim recovery from the destructive attack.

attack_patterns.name: Cloud Secrets Management Stores
attack_patterns.description: Targeted and deleted an Azure Key Vault as part of the destructive phase to impair defenses and remove access to secrets.

identities.name: Microsoft
identities.description: Security vendor that researched and published the detailed analysis of the Storm-3168 (JADEPUFFER) campaign.

identities.name: Microsoft Azure
identities.description: The public cloud platform targeted by the Storm-3168 (JADEPUFFER) threat actor for reconnaissance and data destruction.

identities.name: GitHub
identities.description: Public code repository where service principal credentials may have been accidentally exposed, leading to the initial compromise.

indicators.name: JADEPUFFER - Azure Storage Account Deletion via CLI
indicators.pattern:
title: JADEPUFFER - Azure Storage Account Deletion via CLI
id: 2b3a1c4d-e5f6-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of the Azure CLI command to delete a storage account, a technique used by the JADEPUFFER group for rapid data destruction.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/09/25/storm-3168-agentic-driven-cloud-attacks-using-compromised-service-principals/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
  - attack.t1485
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\az.exe'
      - '/az'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'storage'
      - 'account'
      - 'delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of the Azure CLI to delete a storage account, a destructive action observed in the JADEPUFFER campaign.

indicators.name: JADEPUFFER - Azure Backup Protection Deletion Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: JADEPUFFER - Azure Backup Protection Deletion Attempt
id: 8c9d0e1f-a3b4-4c5d-8e7f-8a9b0c1d2e3f
status: experimental
description: Detects API calls attempting to delete Azure backup protection, a technique used by JADEPUFFER to prevent recovery.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/09/25/storm-3168-agentic-driven-cloud-attacks-using-compromised-service-principals/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
  - attack.t1561
level: critical
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: activitylogs
detection:
  selection:
    OperationName|contains:
      - 'Microsoft.RecoveryServices/vaults/backupFabrics/protectionContainers/protectedItems/delete'
      - 'Microsoft.RecoveryServices/vaults/backupPolicies/delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects API calls aimed at deleting Azure backup policies or protected items, a key tactic of JADEPUFFER to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: JADEPUFFER - Storage Account Key Listing
indicators.pattern:
title: JADEPUFFER - Storage Account Key Listing
id: 4a5b6c7d-e8f9-4a0b-8c1d-2e3f4a5b6c7d
status: experimental
description: Detects the listing of storage account keys, a potential precursor to data access and destruction as seen in JADEPUFFER attacks. This is especially suspicious if performed by a service principal not designated for secrets management.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/09/25/storm-3168-agentic-driven-cloud-attacks-using-compromised-service-principals/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
  - attack.t1526
level: high
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: activitylogs
detection:
  selection:
    OperationName|endswith: '/listkeys/action'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the retrieval of Azure storage account keys, an action used for reconnaissance by JADEPUFFER before the destructive phase.
